name: @nexgen-os/dsmr
description: What the P1 port of a smart meter says: DSMR telegrams (2.2 to 5.0.2, e-MUCS) and P1M5 dongle messages read into plain values, each with its direction, phase and tariff register, dated by the meter clock in UTC with the caller's time zone; problems by name. No database, no network.
